newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat eases on bountiful supply.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat eases on bountiful supply.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat mainly eased in good volume cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchnage, with plentiful supply weighing on prices, traders said.

The price paid to farmers for spot Bahia Blanca wheat was steady at $135, but April Bahia Blanca lost $3 to $143. Cash April maize rose $1 to $101 in low volume. May soybeans slipped $1 to $250, with the market tracking Chicago lower. April sunflower seed gained $1 to $203 in moderate volume.
